messages:
Zoe (sales-ops): Quick heads-up — Liam (liam-newrep) started today. Can someone provision HubSpot, Dialpad (PSTN), and Gong? He says Okta invite expired. @Ana (IT) ? :wave:

Liam (newrep): Hi all :wave: I'm Liam. My Okta invite expired. What do you need from me to get HubSpot + phone?

Ana (IT): I'll take this. If the Okta link expired, go to https://okta.redwood.com/activate and request a new invite from me. What's your employee ID (e.g., RDW-1234)?

Liam (newrep): RDW-2178 — thanks. Also, Dialpad shows 'No phone numbers available' when I try to make a test call.

Zoe (sales-ops): For tracking, please use this IT ticket template so we don't miss anything:
```
Subject: New hire access - Liam RDW-2178
Body: Okta invite resend
HubSpot seat: yes
Dialpad: need PSTN DID + outgoing caller ID set to +1-415-555-xxxx
Gong: add to 'Sales - AE' team
Priority: high
```

Ana (IT): Got it. Resent Okta invite (should arrive in a few mins). I've assigned a HubSpot seat. Dialpad needs a phone number claim from our DID pool — tagging @Michael (cs) to confirm the caller ID and region.

Michael (cs): Confirmed — please use caller ID +1-415-555-0102 and PSTN region US-PST. Also dropped onboarding playbooks here: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1sales-onboarding (view only) — see 'Dialer setup' and 'Gong call templates'.

Liam (newrep): Okta invite came through, I completed activation. HubSpot login works. Gong link gives me a 403 error: "Access denied - not part of org"

Ana (IT): That's a permissions sync issue. I added you to the 'Sales - AE' group in our SSO mapping. Give it 5 minutes and try login. If still 403, paste the exact error text.

Liam (newrep): Now Gong login works! Dialpad still shows 'No available numbers' when making outbound. Error: `NoDIDsAvailable: please contact admin`

Zoe (sales-ops): @Ana (IT) can you check the DID pool? If we need to purchase an extra DID or reassign, what's the ETA? Also, Liam — for now you can use the shared pool softphone for outbound until we assign a number.

Ana (IT): I reallocated +1-415-555-0102 to Liam. Should be in Dialpad under Devices > Numbers. Try logging out/in or re-sync: `Settings > Account > Re-sync SSO`

Liam (newrep): I see the number now, test call went through. One last thing — voicemail transcription isn't enabled on my account. Is that intentional?

Michael (cs): We enable transcripts for AEs. @Ana (IT) can flip that flag. Also review the 'First week call checklist' in the Drive folder.

Ana (IT): Turned on voicemail transcription and set retention per policy. All done. Ticket RDW-2026 closed. :white_check_mark:

Liam (newrep): Everything works, thanks team! :raised_hands:
